_comment: Small-instance supplement to the pilot (B6, 9 Nov; needs the group's OK before it is run). Reason: the main pilot gave EASY 2 / MEDIUM 1 against targets 4 / 5, and only n = 50 was easy. Same generator, same seed 201, same W = 0.75 L and same pilot limits as pilot/grid.json; n = 20-80, m in {2, 3}, L in {360, 480}: 20 configurations, 19 run. Excluded: rt_n20_m3_L480_s201, whose reference schedule has a median of 2.5 trips per duty (< 3, density rule Q2), checked in memory on 9 Nov before this file was written. Results go to results/pilot_small.csv (run: python -m pilot.run_pilot --grid pilot/grid_small.json --out results/pilot_small.csv) and are classified together with results/pilot.csv by the same written rule. Separate file because the runner's machine fingerprint for this laptop changed on 9 Nov (C's RAM-unit fix: 8.3 GB -> 7.7 GiB, same CPU and cores), and results/pilot.csv must stay single-machine for C's chart test.
_mem_comment: MemLimit 6 GB = the value the main pilot ran with (decimal-GB rounding before C's GiB fix of 9 Nov), so all pilot rows share ONE configuration hash. Non-binding here: the supplement's largest run used 220 MB. The first supplement batch (MemLimit 5 GB, 76 rows) is kept in results/pilot_small.csv marked superseded.
